scope: Existing synthetic native blockdispatcher/async-queue cases as explicit Spectra STORAGE selection.

implementation.ownership: Spectra owns selection and common text/JSON/export. Existing privileged synthetic cases stay at native block storage, separated into cases/backend/session/live source units. No physical fault-test disk or global queue/counter reset.
implementation.cases: Same slow/fast controller, depth2/reordered and replayed completion, I/O kill/unregister barriers, reset/late ticket, real timeout/cancel, flush order and partial batch payload scenarios. Eight case masks; no independent performance index.
implementation.identity: Native exact-reference registration/pin/read/flush/reset and retirement-begin wrappers share existing owners. The reference is checked under the same short metadata owner as admission; reused indexes cannot redirect work. Existing C ABI and production rollback remain.
implementation.resources: Resident own device/task/request ledger, exact last-pin retirement and unregister commits. Cleanup aborts future requester entry, releases only the own slow callback, acknowledges own synthetic requests, waits actual request bodies and task resource/metadata return, then unregisters own devices. Late or ambiguous work retains backing/session/gate. Idle unregister may wait boundedly after the existing false/rollback acknowledgment, revalidating the same exact reference at every attempt; busy-I/O negative cases observe immediate refusal.
implementation.kill_proof: Requester tasks retain the actual I/O unwind guards; no added diagnostic Admission guard can make the original kill-barrier case trivially pass. Exact own Ready/Blocked I/O task generation/unwind state and kill result replace global denial-counter deltas.
implementation.completion: The original void IRQ callback shares its body with an internal typed completion disposition. Normal callbacks discard it without a diagnostic hook. Exact replay/late rejection receipts and own per-device stats replace global comparisons; a replay rejected after original caller retirement is reported distinctly.
implementation.worker_pool: Diagnostic requester/controller tasks need exact retirement. Cached production block-controller worker lanes remain production-owned; all three own synthetic device registrations must be unregistered.
implementation.api: Append-only R4DEVv18 slot52 at432 after unchanged432-byte prefix, total440. ProgramKernelBlockQueueCheck v1 fixed240bytes; Contract0.64.15/SDK0.64.27 public exact pins required before acceptance.
implementation.counter_semantics: Existing read_ops/write_ops count only successful operations at block_device_state operation9; error cases are accounted separately at operation10. The original scenario completes6 successful reads,1 successful write and1 flush, while all9 async requests include the intended reset/timeout/partial-write errors.
